title: Metastore-level ABAC policies are in Beta
body:
Metastore-level ABAC policies are in [Beta](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types) in Unity Catalog. You can now attach an ABAC policy (row filter, column mask, GRANT, or DENY) at the metastore level, so a single policy applies across every catalog in the metastore, including catalogs created later. This gives governance teams one place to enforce organization-wide data protection rules without replicating a policy for each catalog.

For details, see [Metastore-level ABAC policies (Beta)](/aws/en/data-governance/unity-catalog/abac/metastore-policies).
